description: This file defines the interface for B2HGraphicBufferProducer, a wrapper around IGraphicBufferProducer, used in Android's graphics buffer queue system. It declares methods for buffer management, connection handling, and querying buffer states.

classes.name: B2HGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: A wrapper class that extends HGraphicBufferProducer, providing methods to interact with the underlying IGraphicBufferProducer interface.

methods.name: setMaxDequeuedBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be dequeued.

methods.name: requestBuffer
methods.description: Requests a buffer from the buffer queue.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the producer.

methods.name: detachNextBuffer
methods.description: Detaches the next buffer in the queue.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to the producer.

methods.name: cancelBuffer
methods.description: Cancels a buffer that was dequeued.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries information about the buffer queue.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection with a listener.

methods.name: setGenerationNumber
methods.description: Sets the generation number for buffers.

methods.name: setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for dequeuing buffers.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for the buffer producer.

methods.name: getConsumerName
methods.description: Gets the name of the buffer consumer.
